text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's the last day of summer camp,<n>and Biwa
Hayahide has improved so<n>much that she's almost
a different<n>racer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I thought she might've gained more<n>confidence as
well, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So, Ticket is her biggest threat?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At this point, I'm not sure if I'll ever<n>catch up to
those two...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can barely hear what she murmurs<n>as she stares
at a huge thundercloud.<n>She's clearly still anxious.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that I need to come<n>up with a new
way to encourage her<n>and break her out of this
funk.
